brief:
The Gaza Strip's Health Ministry reported Wednesday that five Palestinians were killed over the past 24 hours, including four newly slain and one who died from previous wounds, Shehab Wire reported. Eleven others were wounded and treated at hospitals across the territory during the same period.

The deaths come as fighting continues in the Gaza Strip on the third anniversary of the war.

title: Gaza Health Ministry reports five Palestinians killed in 24 hours
